offense_injuries.espn_comment: Pittman (foot) is warmed up with his teammates Thursday, though he remains on IR and wasn't wearing a helmet, Nick Farabaugh of PennLive.com reports.
The Steelers designated Harmon (foot) for return from injured reserve Wednesday, Ray Fittipaldo of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette reports.
Queen compiled 10 tackles (seven solo), including 1.0 sacks, during Pittsburgh's win over the Saints on Sunday.
Rodgers completed 13 of 25 passes for 172 yards with no touchdowns and one interception in the Steelers' 27-6 win over the Browns on Sunday.
Wilson totaled six tackles (three solo) and an interception during Pittsburgh's win over the Saints on Sunday.
Warren rushed 17 times for 143 yards and a touchdown and brought in one of two targets for no gain in the Steelers' 27-6 win over the Browns on Sunday. He also fumbled once but recovered.
Watt (calf) practiced fully Friday and doesn't carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Saints.
Freiermuth caught both of his targets for 35 yards in Sunday's 27-6 win over the Browns. He added one rushing attempt for a one-yard touchdown.
Washington caught three of five targets for 94 yards during Sunday's 27-6 win over the Browns.
Bernard caught all five of his targets for 30 yards during Sunday's 27-6 win against Cleveland.
Dowdle rushed 15 times for 56 yards and a touchdown in the Steelers' 27-6 win over the Browns on Sunday.
The Steelers signed Smith off the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Teresa Varley of the team's official site reports.
Elliott was a full participant in practice Thursday, Mike DeFabo of The Athletic reports.
Skowronek (calf) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice, Teresa Varley of the Steelers' official site reports.
Echols (hamstring) was a full participant at practice Wednesday, Teresa Varley of the Steelers' official site reports.
Slaughter (hamstring) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice, Teresa Varley of the Steelers' official site reports.
Rudolph is active for Sunday's game against the Saints in Paris, Teresa Varley of the Steelers' official site reports.
Metcalf brought in one of six targets for four yards in the Steelers' 27-6 win over the Browns on Sunday.
Boswell made two of his three field-goal attempts and all three PATs in the Steelers' 27-6 win over the Browns on Sunday.

team_projection.note: Bootstrap of each team's real quarter scores. 'matchup_pair' includes the opponent's defence; 'independent' is the legacy sampler. phase_ledger.detail: Market spread/total, neutral pass rate, pace. The script call itself is the analyst's.

phase_ledger.name: Defender assignment and explosive allowance
phase_ledger.detail: Per-defender targets/yards allowed (PFR) and explosive plays allowed. Who covers whom is NOT known.

phase_ledger.name: QB pressure, blitz, scramble
phase_ledger.detail: Sack rate, sacks + QB hits rate (a floor on pressure), blitz rate, scrambles.

phase_ledger.name: Offensive line, pass rush, coaching
phase_ledger.detail: Depth-chart line, pressure allowed, run yards by direction, pass-rush leaders. No line grades.

phase_ledger.name: Injury and depth chart
phase_ledger.detail: Official weekly report and depth chart; ESPN live list when reachable. Recent roster arrivals/departures.

phase_ledger.name: Weather, roof, travel
phase_ledger.detail: Roof, surface, rest days, site; National Weather Service kickoff forecast: OK.

phase_ledger.name: Timestamped book prices
phase_ledger.detail: Pinnacle / DraftKings / FanDuel prices with no-vig and first-seen-to-now movement, no player props in this run. No FTN model, no true opening line.

phase_ledger.name: Projection and simulation
phase_ledger.detail: Period-engine team scores; player baselines. Not the three-model consensus; not validated.

phase_ledger.name: Final inactive pregame freeze
phase_ledger.detail: Inactives post about 90 minutes before kickoff. Re-run or check them by hand before any final call.
